name: pwgen
description: Generate custom secure or phonetic passwords using the WASM pwgen engine with configurable CLI flags, password length, and count.

flags.description: CLI flags for pwgen (e.g. '-sy', '-0', '-A', '-B', '-v'). Default is '-sy'.

length.description: Length of each password in characters. Default is 20.

count.description: Number of passwords to generate. Default is 1.
